What could cause this?

Thank you!

Dear Mr. Szilagyi,
I hope you are doing well. Thank you for contacting Technical support team.
As you mentioned the outlets are disabled from sifinity control. So, the outlets remain off. You can control chargers from Sifinity( Normally customer control backend). SCB (Normally our backend). When you turn off from on backend, its automatically sync. to the charger.
Currently the charger looks error free. Let me know if you have further question. Otherwise a quick feedback will help me to close the ticket.
Mit Freundlichen Grüßen/ Melhores Cumprimentos/ Best Regards
Harun Ar Rashid
Technical Support Specialist (eMobility)
Av. 25 de Abril 201, 2845-547, Corroios, Portugal.
Email: harun.ar-rashid.ext@siemens.com
